Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#1 contest — the striving staged: repel + shove pointer (Zeus's separation as the click), turbulence 0.15 (two divine forces contending); the trident carries a repel force (the strike entering the field); the olive grows from seedling to tree (the witnessed planting taking time); the land's two namings walk Cecropia → Athens — the record's naming archaeology in its own order. Duration 13.
#2 aftermath — the flood's three variants as one sea-ring: it swells dark (the accomplished Thriasian flood), recedes pale (Hyginus's prevented inundation); vortex + pulse pointer (the surge), circulation −0.3 (the sea's pull-back). Duration 12.
#3 sanctuary — THE 3D SCENE. z is the precinct's two levels: Athena's olive at the eastern, upper dedication (z +0.4), the Erechtheion between (z 0), the trident mark and salt spring in the lower western shrine (z −0.45) — the victorious civic form retaining the counter-claim below itself, literally. The olive's sequence burns and regrows (gold → burnt dark → the green-gold shoot); auto-wave, a slow sine LFO on circulation — the cistern's wave sounding in a south wind; attract pointer (the precinct gathers both cults). Duration 14 — the material memory takes time.
#4 torus — the toroidal image composed in place: the ring wound around the well-disc at centre (both at 0,−0.35), its rotation sequence turning the wound form; the olive chain walked in the record's own stages root→tree → fruit→pressing→oil → anointing→flame/light (tint ripening toward flame); vortex + pulse pointer (circulation around an unfilled depth). Duration 13.
#5→0 return — the fourfold walked T·L·N·N → Topos→Logos → Nomos→Natio → T·L·N·N (operational analogy, held as analogy); the retained-contrary ring settles from sea-dark to the civic violet (standing, not revolt); attract pointer at 0.25 — the gentlest hold in the journey. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens in strife — two claims shoving apart, a land renamed by force of verdict — and closes in the same field at rest: the retained contrary ring holds Poseidon's sign with standing inside Athena's city, the fourfold analogy naming what #1 performed (place → signs → verdict → belonging). The trident of #1 (weapon at the centre) re-enters at #3 as the mark retained in the bedrock — the same Ψ, changed office — and the flood-ring that swelled in #2 settles at #5→0 into the ring of the force that remains without governing. The verdict the arbiters gave in #0 returns to the place it named, now bounded: it determines the city; it does not exhaust the place.
Human-amplified staging: the five ratified relations carry human-amplified: yes in the #4 kicker; the five candidate readings remain deliberately human-amplified: no in the #5→0 body, verbatim. Mythemic verbs only: the contest demonstrates the retained-contrary relation; no dictionary key (Poseidon = #0), no historical or topological claim.
Automation: auto-wave (#3, field.params.circulation sine — the cistern's wave-sound), tied to the record's own reported sign. Durations 12–15 and transitions 1.3–2.2: the sanctuary and the return held longest.
Layouts: #2 aftermath in line (the variant aftermaths in series), #5→0 return in ring (the retained contrary held in the round); the torus scene keeps hand placement so the ring can wind the well at its exact centre.

glyph_rationales.Cecrops: the earth-born king, man and serpent — the autochthonous witness whose double nature sees both signs; his testimony is the verdict's stated ground (Pseudo-Apollodorus 3.14.1).
glyph_rationales.Cecropia: the prior naming — the country formerly called Acte named after its king; the first of the story's two naming events.
glyph_rationales.Ψ: Poseidon's trident — at #1 the strike at the Acropolis's middle that opens the sea called Erechtheis; at #2 the mark retained in the bedrock: weapon become memory.
glyph_rationales.Athens: the civic name given through Athena — the naming that binds the city without exhausting the place.
glyph_rationales.☄: Mercury in Hyginus, Fab. 164 — the prevention of the flood on Jupiter's orders; higher authority restraining the defeated claimant.
glyph_rationales.⚖: the scales — at #1 Augustine's account of the women's outvoting and its reversal; at #3 the verdict's bounded authority.
glyph_rationales.→→→: the olive chain's direction — root to light; the authored chain's flow through cultivation and transformation (record 3.4).
glyph_rationales.root→tree: the chain's first stage — rooted life persisting through seasons and generations.
glyph_rationales.fruit→pressing→oil: the chain's middle stages — the fruit made useful through cultivation and transformation.
glyph_rationales.anointing→flame/light: the chain's completion — nourishment, anointing, burning: the fruit of rooted life become light.
glyph_rationales.5×: the five proposed comparisons held deliberately unratified — presented for encounter, not installed as canon.
glyph_rationales.T·L·N·N: the operational fourfold Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio — an analogical relation, not a claim that the myth encoded the later sixfold.
glyph_rationales.Topos→Logos: place become logos — the claimed Acropolis receiving rival signs, testimony and naming.
glyph_rationales.Nomos→Natio: nomos become natio — divine arbitration and verdict becoming Athens as named civic belonging.
